issues.explanation: docs/api/totem.md keeps the old proposal status lines alongside the new implemented status, leaving contradictory status text.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/PairTotem.php + OpenTotemPairing.php: domain writes via Actions reusing IssueTicket; app/Models/Totem.php:18 + TotemPreset.php:64: #[Fillable] + HasFactory; database/migrations/2026_10_29_033345..47: reversible down(); Log::channel('audit') in OpenTotemPairing.php:60 and TotemAuthController.php:417,428,438; docs/api/totem.md + database-schema.md + architecture.md + CHANGELOG.md updated

readability.evidence: Clear names (PairTotem, TotemContext::assertEntity/resolveQueue, TotemPriority), small methods, consistent style; docs/api/totem.md:7-12 still contains both 'Status: proposal. No routes/api.php implementation' and 'Status: implemented', which is contradictory

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/PairTotem.php:95-124 transaction + lockForUpdate, consumed/expired/inactive checks; app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:416-450 format 400, 401 mapping, 200 token+entity; app/Totem/TotemToken.php:907-925 HS256 claims totem_id/entity_id/preset_id/queues/iat/exp/jti; app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:618-648 401 checks + last_seen_at saveQuietly + queues intersection; TotemQueueController.php:479-504 active-scope ordered-by-name with visual.order; TotemPriority 0/10/20; TotemTicketController.php:567-585 is_int priority, IssueTicket channel totem, 201 A001 sequence; routes/api.php:1788-1801 throttle:10,1 + throttle:30,1; config/cors.php:1048-1049 localhost pattern; migrations match data model; phpunit.xml:1767-1768 pins secret+TTL

scope.evidence: All files serve pairing/JWT/queues/priorities/tickets/throttle/CORS/migrations/factories/docs; no unrelated refactors; CHANGELOG/docs updates required by task

security.evidence: TotemAuthController.php:416 preg_match /\A\d{6}\z/ + never logs code; PairTotem row lock prevents double-pair; AuthenticateTotem.php:621-637 revalidates totem/preset/entity every request to 401 invalid_token; TotemContext.php:246-258 entity-scoped resolveQueue 404 vs 403; TotemToken.php:943-949 rejects secret <32 chars, decode returns null on bad/expired/none alg; config/cors.php:1044-1056 strict localhost pattern, supports_credentials false; throttle rendered as rate_limited in bootstrap/app.php:997-1001

simplicity.evidence: Reuses App\Actions\IssueTicket, firebase/php-jwt (composer.json:1011), Eloquent attach/detach; small focused classes PairedTotem/TotemContext/TotemToken/TotemPriority/TotemApiException, no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Totem/TotemPairingTest.php: pairing window, unknown preset, JWT scope, format/rejection cases, single-use, old-code invalid, 10/min throttle, audit without code; TotemApiTest.php: 401 cases, last_seen_at, queues ordering/visuals, 403/404 scope, intersection immediacy, priorities exact JSON, sequential A001/A002 channel totem, invalid_priority/inactive_queue, 30/min throttle; TotemCorsTest.php + TotemModelsTest.php: preflight 204, origin echo/deny, TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN, factory codes, attach/detach, short-secret, none-alg

review.summary: Implements the full totem BFF: pairing command, JWT auth, scoped queues/priorities/ticket issuance via IssueTicket, throttling, CORS, migrations and docs, with comprehensive Pest coverage. Approve with one docs nit: the old proposal status lines remain alongside the new implemented status in docs/api/totem.md.
